harness.rule: harness_bias_detected = (A/A unadjusted 95% interval excludes 0) or (server-equivalence unadjusted 95% interval excludes 0); if detected, or if a control is missing, every stage-3 verdict is suspended; otherwise B = max over the two controls of max(|lo95|, |hi95|) and H1 uses max(0, B)

run1.rule: both S conditions: Holm (m=2) 95% lower bound of g2-g3 > max(0, B) with B the harness bias bound, and the mean of the two Holm lower bounds >= 1.0 ms

run2.rule: both S conditions: Holm (m=2) 95% lower bound of g2-g3 > max(0, B) with B the harness bias bound, and the mean of the two Holm lower bounds >= 1.0 ms

H1.claim: improvement claimed (run 1 H1 passed, run 2 same direction in both S conditions)
H1.same_direction_rule: run 2 point estimates of g2-g3 > 0 in both S conditions

run1.rule: every S, D and H condition: Holm 95% lower bound of g2-g3 > -1.0 ms (Holm step-down rejection); categories per condition: '비열등 확인' if that holds, otherwise '열등 확인' if a separate Holm step-down over the same family for H0: g2-g3 >= 0 rejects (its Holm upper bound < 0), else '판정불능(검정력 부족)'
run1.reading: '판정불능(검정력 부족)' means the interval was too wide to decide; it is not evidence that g3 is slower

run2.rule: every S, D and H condition: Holm 95% lower bound of g2-g3 > -1.0 ms (Holm step-down rejection); categories per condition: '비열등 확인' if that holds, otherwise '열등 확인' if a separate Holm step-down over the same family for H0: g2-g3 >= 0 rejects (its Holm upper bound < 0), else '판정불능(검정력 부족)'
run2.reading: '판정불능(검정력 부족)' means the interval was too wide to decide; it is not evidence that g3 is slower

H3.rule: H cells with sealed delta_hat >= 2 ms: Holm (within those cells) 95% lower bound of g2-g3 > 0 and observed/predicted in [0.5, 2.0]; other H cells: H2 only

H4.rule: exploratory: write 'adaptation contributed' for an S condition only if the Holm (m=2) 95% lower bound of (g3-fixed minimax) - g3 > 0

H5.rule: report only: cold first-visit mean HCT and bytes (cache cleared every 8 connections)

regression.rule: report only; excluded from H2 and H3 families; g2_minus_g3 is the unadjusted 95% interval, not a test; stage2_reference is the same cell in stage 2 (development data, shown side by side only)

rules.guard_resid_missing_ok_rows: successful rows with a finite j3_pred_pre_ms but no finite guard_resid_ms; should be 0
